name: project-thread-orchestrator
description: Plan, preview, create, initialize, list, synchronize, and safely archive persistent Codex project threads through the public Codex App Server.

interface.shortDescription: Turn project capsules into safe Codex task threads.
interface.longDescription: Pairs a project-capsule planning Skill with a local stdio MCP server. It validates and previews a 3-12 milestone DAG, waits for explicit user confirmation, then creates persistent named Codex threads through codex app-server and initializes each thread without executing its milestone.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $project-thread-orchestrator:project-capsule-orchestrator to audit, adapt, preview, then stop for explicit confirmation.
